## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Winded | The effort drains you faster than expected. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength. | Moderate |  |
| 14-16 | Shaking Limbs | Cold, exhaustion, or pain makes your body tremble. Your pace and confidence falter. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Cramping Pain | Muscles seize under the strain of the journey. You must stop briefly and lose valuable time. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Numb Extremities | Bitter weather or overuse deadens your hands and feet. Suffer 1 point of damage to Agility. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Ragged Breathing | You push too hard and cannot catch your breath. The next stretch of travel or struggle becomes slower and harsher. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Feverish Chill | Exposure starts to settle into your body. Roll for the effects of cold, or worsen an existing cold condition. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Collapse at Rest | When you finally stop, your legs nearly give out beneath you. You cannot keep going without a meaningful pause. | Moderate |  |
| 44-46 | Pain Takes Over | Whatever hurt you were ignoring surges back to the front. You lose the ability to push on without help or shelter. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Exhausted March | You keep moving, but at too great a cost. Everyone depending on your pace loses time or ground this stretch. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Exposure Damage | The road, cold, or suffering bites deep. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength and 1 point to Agility. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Body Gives Out | You can no longer force yourself onward. You fall prone or become unable to continue until treated or rested. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Frozen or Broken | The strain of pain and exposure becomes life-threatening. Immediate aid or shelter is needed to prevent disaster. | Catastrophic |  |
